title: Korean Leaf Wrap
description: A low-carb Korean-inspired dish wrapped in a perilla leaf wrap. This keto recipe combines the flavors of zesty Korean chili flakes with the crunch of fresh leafy greens.

ingredients.name: Perilla Leaf Wraps
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian markets or online

ingredients.name: Green Leafy Greens (such as lettuce or spinach)
Korean-Style BBQ Sauce (make sure it's sugar-free)

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Brush the perilla leaf wraps with a small amount of oil and cook for 30-45 seconds on each side, until slightly charred.
In a large bowl, combine the cucumber, carrot, and green leafy greens.
Add the sliced avocado and Korean-style BBQ sauce (if using) to the bowl and toss to combine.
To assemble the wraps, place a few slices of the cucumber-carrot mixture onto each cooked perilla leaf wrap.
Sprinkle a pinch of zesty Korean chili flakes on top of the filling.
